description: Header file defining interface functions and including dependencies for AMX ACS connection management in a device management project.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_ACSConnectionInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the ACS connection with specified backend and URI.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_ACSConnectionCleanup
methods.description: Cleans up resources associated with the ACS connection.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_ACSConnectionAddSubscription
methods.description: Adds a subscription for device management notifications.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_ACSConnectionHandleGetwandevice
methods.description: Retrieves WAN device address based on IP.

methods.name: DM_ENG_Device_ACSConnectionHandleGetwaninterface
methods.description: Retrieves WAN interface details based on IP.
